name: Claude Pro

price.note: $20 a month billed monthly, or $200 a year billed up front ($17 a month). US web price; mobile and local prices can differ.

reset.rule: The window opens with your first message and resets in full 5 hours later.
stipulations: claude.ai (web, desktop, mobile), Claude Code, Cowork and IDE use all count toward the same window.
Longer messages, large files, long conversations and heavier models use the window faster.
Once per weekly period, Claude Code may finish a response in progress after you hit this limit ("wrapping up"). That overrun counts toward the weekly limit.

reset.rule: Resets at a fixed day and time assigned to your account.
stipulations: The reset time doesn't move when you start using Claude or when your subscription renews.
Every Claude model and surface counts toward this one weekly limit.
Since 14 Sep 2026, the weekly limit in Claude Code is 25% higher than it was before the May to September promotion. Other Claude products didn't get this increase.
Fable models don't use this limit on Pro. They bill to usage credits.

overage: Blocked at the limit unless you turn on usage credits (Settings → Usage). Credits bill at standard API rates up to a monthly spend limit you set, or unlimited. Credits bought from 7 Dec 2026 expire 12 months after purchase. Pro doesn't include API credits.

how: A 5-hour session window and a weekly window across all models.
Opus, Sonnet and Haiku are included. Fable models are not: they run on usage credits from the first message.
Every Claude surface draws from the same limits.
ext: Claude Code works in VS Code, Cursor and other VS Code forks, and JetBrains IDEs. IDE use counts toward the same limits.
quirks: If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in your environment, Claude Code bills the API instead of your plan.
Claude Code can offer to buy API credits when you hit a limit. Decline to stay on your plan.
The free Fable 5.2 launch week and its one limit reset for Pro expired on 16 Nov 2026.

events.what: Usage credits bought from this date expire 12 months after purchase.
One free full limit reset (all models, 5-hour and weekly) for Pro, Max, Ultra and Team expires at 2:00 pm PT. Look for it under Settings → Usage → Limit resets.
